records.sourceWork: Mass Effect 2 (2010), Garrus after Archangel recruitment
records.prompt: Draw a NEW NATIVE transparent pixel-art game sprite atlas, EXACTLY FOUR columns and FOUR rows, sixteen DIFFERENT whole-body poses. Equal cells with large fully transparent empty gutters. All poses face RIGHT, shoes visible, every weapon fully inside cell. Same physical body scale and adult proportions in all sixteen cells. No background, vignette, shadow backdrop, grid, border, labels, second body, enemy, injury or scene. Exact rows: ARRIVAL four distinct walking/settling poses; PREPARATION four distinct raising/aiming/bracing poses; ATTACK four distinct physical firing/recoil/reset poses; RECOVERY four lowering/withdrawal poses. Do not copy the attached atlas layout or its seven/eight rows, use it ONLY for character identity/costume. Native body and native physical weapon, no detached projectile, no long energy beam, no large flash obscuring anatomy. Garrus Vakarian in ME2(2010): tall lean male turian with blue facial markings, scarred right facial side, targeting visor over his anatomical LEFT eye, swept plated head crest and mandibles. Worn cobalt-blue/charcoal segmented armor, three-finger hands, digitigrade turian legs. His own long conventional futuristic sniper rifle, dark metal barrel with scope. Keep his alien head and feet fully inside every cell with a wide top margin; no human face or helmet. Action is his real weapon-launched Concussive Shot, NOT biotics, magic wings, Archangel aura, proximity mine, or eye beam. Arrival carry rifle in two hands; preparation settle stock and aim to right; attack four evolving aim/fire/recoil/reset poses with at most a TINY pale blue muzzle pulse from the barrel; recovery lowers rifle and backs away. Exactly4x4, alpha-transparent.
